questions.text:
In a isobaric process work done by gas is 200 J. Adiabatic exponent of the gas is 1.4, then find the heat supplied to the gas during the process.
(1) 200 J
(2) 400 J
(3) 600 J
(4) 700 J

steps:
$\mathrm{W}=\mathrm{nR} \Delta \mathrm{T}=200$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\mathrm{Q}=\mathrm{nC}_{p} \Delta \mathrm{~T} \\
=\frac{\mathrm{ny} \mathrm{R} \Delta \mathrm{~T}}{\gamma-1} \\
\mathrm{Q}=\left(\frac{1.4}{0.4}\right) \times 200 \\
\mathrm{Q}=14 \times 50 \\
\mathrm{Q}=700 \mathrm{~J}
\end{array}$$

questions.text:
If the velocity of the particle is given by $\mathrm{v}=4 \sqrt{\mathrm{x}}$. Find the acceleration of particle.
(1) $2 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$
(2) $4 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$
(3) $8 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$
(4) $16 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$

steps:
$$\begin{aligned}
& v=4 \sqrt{x} \\
& \frac{d v}{d t}=\frac{d(4 \sqrt{x})}{d t} \\
\Rightarrow & a=\frac{4}{2 \sqrt{x}}\left(\frac{d x}{d t}\right) \\
\Rightarrow & a=\frac{4}{2 \sqrt{x}}(4 \sqrt{x}) \\
\Rightarrow & a=8 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}
\end{aligned}$$

questions.text:
At temperature 25°C resistance of wire AB is $3 \Omega$. Now the wire is cooled at the rate of 2° C/s. After 10 sec. the deflection in galvanometer is 0. Find temperature coefficient of resistance of wire AB.
(1) $1 \times 10^{-3}$
(2) $1 \times 10^{-2}$
(3) $1 \times 10^{-4}$
(4) $1 \times 10^{-5}$

steps:
$\quad \mathrm{T}_{\text {initial }}=25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$
$$\begin{array}{c}
\mathrm{T}_{\text {final }}=25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}-\left(2 \times 10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right) \\
=5^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \\
\Delta \mathrm{~T}=5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}-25^{\circ} \mathrm{C} \\
=-20^{\circ} \mathrm{C}
\end{array}$$

When deflection of galvanometer is 0 , this is balanced Wheatstone bridge.
$$\begin{array}{l}
\frac{0.8}{1}=\frac{\left(R_{A B}\right)_{T}}{3}=\left(R_{A B}\right)_{T}=2.4 \\
\Rightarrow\left(R_{A B}\right)_{T}=R_{A B}\left[1+\alpha\left(T-25^{\circ} C\right)\right] \\
\Rightarrow 2.4=3(1+\alpha \Delta T) \\
\Rightarrow-0.2=\alpha \Delta T \\
\Rightarrow \alpha=\frac{-0.2}{\Delta T}=\frac{-0.2}{-20^{\circ} C}=1 \times 10^{-2}
\end{array}$$

questions.text:
Efficiency of a transformer is 80\%. Input voltage is 10 volt and input power is 4 kW . Find output current if output voltage is 240 volt.
(1) $\frac{40}{3} \mathrm{~A}$
(2) $\frac{20}{3} \mathrm{~A}$
(3) $\frac{20}{7} \mathrm{~A}$
(4) $\frac{10}{3} \mathrm{~A}$

steps:
$\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{i}}=10 \mathrm{~V}, \quad \mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{i}}=4 \mathrm{~kW}$ efficiency is 80\%
$$\begin{array}{ll}
\therefore & P_{i} \times \frac{80}{100}=\left(V_{\text {output }}\right) I_{\text {output }} \\
\Rightarrow & \left(4 \times 10^{3}\right) \frac{80}{100}=240 \times I_{\text {output }} \\
\Rightarrow & I_{\text {output }}=\frac{40}{3} A
\end{array}$$
